page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening) with running text in one column; a running head at the top centre; the page number at top right; a woodcut initial at the start of the chapter text; a catchword/signature line at the foot ("K 3" and "dici:"). Left of the text block, the facing page's margin fragments are visible at the scan edge and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Sumptis igitur argenti pondo 3 3 pretij 1 6, poterunt sumi pondo 3 3 pretij 1 4, pondo 9 9 pretij 2 0, & 1 6 5 pretij 1 2. Sumi poterunt (inquam) non sumentur. Quoniam enim hîc uterque extremorum numerus, multitudinis numerus est: idcirco Alligatio multiplex esse poterit, ut suprà ad definitionem primæ alligationis adnotaui.
Seruatis eorundem generum pretijs, si sumpta essent pondo 6 pretij 1 6, & 8 pretij 1 2, ut mistum pondo valeat 1 5, sic dices:
main_text.l: ergo 6 pondo pretij 1 6, requirent 3 o pondo pretij 1 2.
main_text.p: Itaque ad illa octo pondo pretij 1 2, addenda erunt pondo 2 2 eiusdem pretij. Cætera ex superioribus facillima sunt.
main_text.head: CAPVT XXV.
De prima alligatione secundi generis.
main_text.p: PRIMA Alligatio primi generis dicta est. Secundi generis Alligatio prima est, quæ dato toto e numeris optatis, particulares omnes proportione per additionem composita concludit.
Hæc composita proportio regula Societatis vulgò dicitur.

page.notes: The woodcut initial P is joined to "RIMA" as "PRIMA". The left-hand fragments (e.g. "Itaq", "um ats", "nem", "pon") belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Uncertain readings: "ergo 6 pondo" and the sum "3 o pondo" are as printed. The running head is taken as "PARS II." and the page number "149".
